note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Page title bar -- renders: 'Recent changes' heading and help link
Appearance settings panel -- renders: 'Appearance' label, font size options (Small, Standard, Large), width options (Standard, Full width), theme options (System, Day, Night)

Footer -- renders: Privacy policy, About Wikipedia, Disclaimers, Contact Wikipedia, Legal & safety contacts, Code of conduct, Developers, Statistics, Cookie statement, Mobile view, Wikimedia Foundation and MediaWiki logos
Legend for recent changes list -- renders: fixed labels for edit types (Wikibase edit, Damaging, New page, Minor edit, Bot edit, +/− bytes, Watchlist expiry)
